about_the_game:
“Meow Cafe” invites players into the heartwarming world of a quaint cat cafe. As the owner, you’ll blend the art of business management with the joy of feline companionship. Your mission is to transform a charming cafe into a sanctuary for cats and a haven for customers alike. In this delightful virtual world, you’ll serve coffee and desserts to customers, rescue stray cats, and facilitate adoptions. Inspired by real-life characters from New York City, Meow Cafe weaves heartwarming stories centered around the bonds between cats and humanity.

Step into the paws of Lucy, a passionate cat lover in the heart of New York City, as you take on the role of a cat café owner.

Discover and rescue a variety of adorable cats, each with unique personalities and stories. Provide them with a safe home in your café, and match them with the perfect adopters to ensure they find their forever families.

Meet fascinating characters. Engage in heartfelt conversations, uncover their personal stories, and build meaningful connections as they become part of your café’s journey.

Enhance your café experience by upgrading your menu with delicious new food and specialty cat items.

Embark on this heartwarming adventure filled with love, laughter, and life-changing moments. Your journey as a cat café owner awaits—are you ready to make a difference, one cat at a time?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450, 1 GB or AMD Radeon R7 240, 1 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Step into Meow Cafe, a charming virtual world where you serve coffee and desserts, rescue stray cats, and help them find loving homes. Inspired by real-life stories from New York City, this game beautifully captures the heartwarming connections between cats and people.
